speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 道は間違ってないはずなのに…
original_en:
I know we're in the right place. It's
supposed to be here.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: どっかに仕掛けとか秘〓の扉でもあるんじゃないか…？
original_en:
There's gotta be some sort of contraption
or a secret door or something!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: アリーシャ 見ろよ ほら！やっぱりここで間違いなかったんだ！
original_en:
Alicia, check it out!
I knew this was the right place!

speaker: Heimdall
original_jp: 貴様なぜ この〓を通る事ができる？
original_en: Hey, you! How did you get through the gate?

speaker: Heimdall
original_jp: 追え！ 決して〓つけるな！
original_en:
After them! Bring them back to me
unscathed.

speaker: Heimdall
original_jp: あの女… エルフではなかったようだが
original_en: That girl... She didn't look like an elf.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 〓き目が出たら一気に〓け〓けるんだぞいいな？
original_en:
Once the powder starts kicking in, we
run for it. Got it?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …今ならまだ 引き返せる
original_en: It's still not too late to turn back.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: やっぱり よそうリスクが大きすぎる…
original_en:
We shouldn't do it.
It's too risky.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 今さら何を言い出すの！？
original_en: How can you say that all of a sudden!?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: なんだって こんな時に…

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: ルーファス… 行って！

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: バカ野郎ッ！ 戦うんだッ！

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 立てるか？ そろそろ行けるかもしれない
original_en:
Can you stand? Maybe we can go through
soon.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 俺が必ず〓グドラシルの頂上へ連れてってやる！
original_en:
I promise you. You're coming with me to
the top of Yggdrasil.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: ここじゃまだ外せないのか…
original_en: I'm not safe yet without the ring.

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Can you walk? We need to hurry.
